translation: YHWH ⟨es⟩ para mí en ⟨los⟩ que me ayudan; y yo miraré ⟨a⟩ ⟨los⟩ que me odian

tokens.rationale: The preposition לְ means 'to' or 'for'; the pronominal suffix יִ means 'me'. English requires the verb 'es' (copula) for natural reading.
Literally 'in my helpers'. The preposition בְ can mean 'in', 'among', or 'by'. The context implies YHWH is among those who help. English requires the definite article 'los' (the).
The conjunction וְ means 'and'. The pronoun אֲנִי means 'I'.
The verb רָאָה means 'to see' or 'to look upon, gaze upon'. English requires the preposition 'a' before a direct object of seeing a person.

Literally 'in my haters' or 'in those who hate me'. The preposition בְ means 'in' or 'among'. English requires the definite article 'los' (the) and the relative pronoun 'que' (that/who) to make sense of the participle.
